content:
mia: Who wants to do two things next Tuesday at lunch: a tiny World Cup pick'em pool ($1) plus the long-awaited office ping-pong finals? :soccer: :table_tennis: Ill bring a raffle jersey for the winner.
ben: yes to both. $1 is basically a donation. count me in for ping-pong too.
katie: ill enter the pool. ping-pong status: i have terrible backhand but big heart.
jorge: in for pool. for ping-pong, open challenge: loser buys nachos for the viewing party.
devbot: Reminder: please include your slack handle in payment notes. Use Venmo @redwood-social.
mia: format:
- World Cup pick'em: $1 entry, pick each knockout winner, tiebreaker = total goals in final.
- Ping-pong: 6 players, double-elim, 2 of 3 games to 11.
- Jersey raffle: each $1 pool entry = one raffle ticket; ping-pong winner gets 3 extra tickets.
ben: love a raffle. what jersey is it?
mia: vintage club throwback someone donated. green with tiny stains, very authentic. :grin:
katie: question: can viewers bet on players (fun pool), or is that chaos?
jorge: small side bet allowed but keep it friendly. losers wear the jersey for 1 photo.
devbot: Poll created: "Enter World Cup $1 pick'em?" Options: 👍 Yes, 👎 No. Expires in 48h.
ben: timezone heads-up: our APAC folks, we miss you. will post results and stream highlights.
mia: signups: comment here with emoji to join the pool and ping-pong. i'll lock the sheet at 11am Tuesday. spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/wcup-pingpong
katie: sign me up :raised_hands: (pool + ping-pong)
jorge: sign me up :soccer: (pool only, saving elbow energy)
ben: sign me up :table_tennis: (ping-pong + side bet $2 on myself)
calendar-bot: Event created: "World Cup Pick'em + Office Ping-Pong Finals" Tue 12:30pm.
mia: logistics: table loaned by facilities, portable net, plastic paddles. bring your own paddle if youre fancy.
katie: backup if it rains = hallway foosball consolation tournament. low ceilings, high drama.
ben: i'll bring nachos supplies for the viewing party, unless i lose and then someone else buys them.
jorge: will people streaming the matches want the projector? i can lug it from meeting room B.
mia: yes projector please. will coordinate with facilities.
devbot: Reminder scheduled: "Bring paddles / venmo $1" Tue 9:00am.
ben: ok this is going to be chaotic and perfect. see you Tuesday."
